description: Rename-aware relabel SOUNDNESS — stem-swap (task #64). The relabel is PER-(gate,code): relabeling residue-code-A's old->new never touches residue-code-B (and P1 fails for B — old_path carried no B frozen key). So when a move drops residue-A but ADDS a residue-B line, the A key relabels cleanly (A GREEN/tolerated) but the candidate's NEW B key at the new path is current\frozen = a NEW regression AND proposed\frozen = ratchet growth vs the (unmoved) frozen B set => RED under residue-code-B. The per-code scoping is what closes the swap. The firewall is content-blind, so the codes are opaque by design. Pinned in the emitter's relabel_red_stem_swap_is_per_code_scoped unit test.
